segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and t-zone oil, smoother texture, and fewer breakouts, with some noting less oiliness within days.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report hydration and calming of flaking or eczema-like patches, though one reviewer with drier skin said the serum dried her skin out more than it moisturized.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (often oily T-zone, dry elsewhere) report balanced oiliness, smoother texture and reduced redness, with generally positive results.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several describe calming of redness, rosacea and breakouts with no irritation, while others report stinging, itching, or a reaction severe enough to stop use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-50s+) report smoother, softer, more even-toned skin and compliments on appearance, with no negative reports specific to this group.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report smoother, softer skin and compliments on looking younger; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most report the serum hydrates without stickiness or dryness, but a few describe dryness, flaking, or a white peeling film after use.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report a visible reduction in facial redness and rosacea-related flushing over weeks; no dissenting reports of increased redness from this concern group specifically, though irritation-driven redness is reported elsewhere.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports improved skin barrier when paired with an AHA and moisturizer, though notes pilling limits use under sunscreen or makeup.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, sun spots, and hyperpigmentation over weeks to months; a couple say they've seen no noticeable change yet after only a week or two of use.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report fewer breakouts, faster healing of blemishes, and reduced acne scarring, but several reviewers report new whiteheads, cystic pimples, or breakouts starting soon after use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers report visibly reduced oil production, especially in the T-zone/nose, with balanced skin by end of day; no significant dissent on this point.

extraits.texte: I recently purchased product, did a patch test it was fine. But, after putting on my face still had a reaction to it. Stinging and itching. Even two days later still itching. Just did not work for me , too strong for my sensitive skin. But, did like the consistency of it and no scent.

i started using this with some persistent cheek acne & scars that kept becoming pimples again & overall very textured skin. since going through 1.5 bottles, my skin isn't as textured, my complexion is starting to look more even, i don't get any new acne breakouts (only small, non painful whiteheads) and everyday my acne scars fade more. great if your skin is sensitive, dull, textured & breakout prone. works best if you apply 2 pumps and let dry completely before moisturizer!

extraits.titre: Go-to Serum for my Combination Skin
extraits.texte: My skincare routine for my face consists mainly of Mad Hippie products. But when researching ingredients to hone in on my needs, I found this product. It has been a game changer for my combination face—oily t-zone with neutral or dry elsewhere. Mad Hippie products already containe niacinamide in their creams and lotions. But switching out the serum to this one made the across-the-board difference in my facial skin over 2-3 months: smoother, consistently hydrated, balanced oiliness even with my cycles, and at least some reduction of redness in my T-zone (possibly rosacea). Since that time I've tried other serums and face creams in my lineup over 1 1/2 years. But nothing gives quite the level of results when using the Naturium niacinnamide serum in my lineup.

I never get compliments on my skin. I've had severe cystic acne for 7 years that leave hypopigmentation and I've begun to develop a few dark spots from 30+ years of sun exposure. At the start of my second bottle of this, I actually got multiple compliments on the tone and texture of my skin! It truly does even out tone and minimize the appearance of pores. I do sometimes wish they had a dimethicone free version.

I have extremely sensitive skin and seem to break out at the drop of a dime, ive been using this along with the jelly cleanser for about a month and my break outs are significantly less, my akin is more even and less red and it isn't drying it out. I 1000% am keeping this routine.

This is one of the few products I can truly say has made a huge and noticeable improvement in my skin. I have light skin with a lot of redness. This was always a problem for me. I get red very easily and my nose was just ALWAYS red no matter what I did. Since using this regularly, only every other night, this has magically gone away! The redness is practically gone after a month or so. I used to feel self conscious without makeup. But now I go without foundation or concealer to work every day! My skin looks better than ever. At first this did sting a little when I would put it on. Only for a few minutes or so. But after a month that doesn't happen anymore.

I really tried and wanted to like this so bad. But it just didnt work for me i've been using it for about 3 weeks now. Morning and night following the directions. The first time using it i noticed white patches on my face and this white peeling film all over my face. I figured maybe i was using too much but even when using a little i would get the same results. This stuff actually dried my skin out than moisturized it.
